text:
Maris: kicking off AP-east-2 cloud account + VNet boot. objective: project + networking + quotas ready so infra can provision GPU nodes tomorrow morning.

Samir: ok. what's the CIDR plan and any shared-services gotchas?

Maris: targeting 10.48.0.0/16 for ap-east-2. carveouts: control-plane 10.48.0.0/22, gpu-subnets 10.48.16.0/20, apps 10.48.32.0/21. no overlap per net-alloc doc.

Linh: route topology: public NAT subnets in az-a/b, private gpu and app subnets in az-a/b/c. prefer autoscaling NATs to limit bill shock.

axis-networking: noted. we'll configure NAT-gateway autoscale with cap and fallback to NAT instances if needed. also block any cross-region peering to prod-core until SRE signoff.

Yara: quota status: A100-40GB quota request opened (ticket #INC-012345). currently in review. we have a temporary burst pool but need guaranteed capacity for the rollout.

Maris: timeline: if quota green by EOD we do terraform apply in staging tonight and dry-run prod-account at 08:00 UTC tomorrow. need a concise handoff checklist and validation steps.

Samir: cost guard rails: create per-project spend alert, set cluster max GPUs to 40 by default, add mandatory tags (team:redwood-ml, env:prod, region:ap-east-2). finance must approve any increase.

Linh: post-provision checks I'll run:
```
# list subnets
gcloud compute networks subnets list --filter=region=asia-east2
# confirm route to NAT
gcloud compute routes list --filter="destRange=0.0.0.0/0 AND nextHopType=INSTANCE"
# verify machine types in zone
gcloud compute machine-types list --zones=asia-east2-a --filter="name~'a100'"
```

Maris: add GPU smoke test: spin tiny container, run nvidia-smi, run 10-iter token generation (small model) check latency and output sanity. Fail if CUDA not available or token output missing.

Yara: security items: KMS key provisioned, buckets locked to project SA, audit logs enabled for compute/storage/iam. will attach KMS key ARN to the TF module.

axis-networking: ensure control plane uses private service connect endpoints (private IPs only). no public provision APIs. also pre-seed DNS entries for control-plane LB.

devops-bot: deploy-checklist created: /infra/runbooks/ap-east-2-quickstart.md assigned to Maris. CI gate requires: quotas OK, terraform plan clean, smoke tests pass. tag: #deploy_checklist.

Samir: handoff Qs: who owns the quota ticket if rejected? define instance-type fallback policy (A100 -> alternative). need owners and decision matrix.

Maris: ticket owner: Yara. fallback: preferred path is to delay and use burst pool; fallback 1: reduce to smaller A100 count and stagger rollouts; fallback 2: if forced, allow lower-tier GPUs (G4dn) with autoscaler in conservative mode + lower max concurrency. document perf/cost hit.

Linh: network validation checklist items: ACLs correct, route priorities, NAT health checks, inter-AZ low-latency test under small load, verify private DNS resolution for internal services.

Yara: escalating quota to priority-high with justification: "Dedicated inference capacity for Redwood production rollout - SLA dependent." will paste ticket link when submitted.

Maris: compact handoff checklist to include in runbook:
- quotas approved
- terraform plan + apply in prod-account (with reviewer signoff)
- subnets, route tables, NAT validated
- KMS & audit logging active
- GPU smoke tests pass (nvidia-smi + 10-iter token test)
- cost alerts and max-scaling enforced
- fallback policy agreed and documented

Samir: +1. ping me when terraform plan is green, I'll review tags and cost alerts before apply.

Maris: thanks, updating runbook now and will post ticket link. :rocket:
